body.statement: For every \(P\in\mathcal M_4\), relative to the explicitly mean-differentiable differentiable-in-quadratic-mean experiment \(\mathcal T_P\), the canonical gradient is \(\phi^{\star}=h^{\star\prime}Z\), and every regular estimator of \(\theta_{\mathrm{PTT}}\) has asymptotic variance at least \(V^{\star}\).
body.justification: The tangent equality converts the rank-one mean manifold into a sharp semiparametric lower bound rather than a formal generalized-method-of-moments projection.
body.gap: Chamberlain (1987) and Newey (1990) provide projection machinery, while Moreau--Kastler (2025, Section 3.2.2) provides no tangent experiment or efficiency bound for the proportional ratio.
body.consumer: The bound is the precision benchmark needed to assess PPML inference in the regional-trade-agreement and treaty applications.
